raw_segments.text: Comineus, if I should tell thee o'er this thy day's work, thou't not believe thy deeds.
But I'll report it where senators shall mingle tears with smiles, where great patricians
shall attend and shrug, I T.H. and admire, where ladies shall be frightened and gladly
quaked hear more, where the dull tribunes that with the fusty plebeians hate thine honors
shall say against their hearts, we think the gods our Rome hath such a soldier.
Yet camsteth thou to a morsel of this feast, having fully dined before.
